poses.mode: mate above/outside tray; cable dressed before seating; no installed latch access claimed
mate above/outside tray; cable dressed before seating; no installed latch access claimed

sequence: Join empty tray halves first; leave Main plugs free.
Hold Wing with underside accessible above tray at underside Z35 or outside tray.
Check L/R and cavity 1; push GHR-14V-S housing horizontally north through 8 mm approach until latch clicks, holding housing rather than wires.
Dress fourteen 1 mm maximum wires through the modeled horizontal fanout into the lower channel; retain slack away from mounting supports.
Lower prewired Wing to underside Z10 while feeding Main end through central bay; seat four mounts and six E-R posts.
Fasten Wing, then mate Main J2/J3 from above. Install the full-cover plate and switches afterward.
For service, power off, disconnect Main and lift Wing before depressing the underside latch.
limits: Pre-mating clearance is a free-space fixture model; PCB held by edges, no keys/plate fitted.
Straight-down seating motion with dressed flexible wires is an assembly procedure, not a rigid-body motion certification.
Use study wall-passage proposal; original tray still blocks the installed harness.
